question: Does a minimal two-coordinate RBS realize activity-dependent state writing S -> H_A -> H_K while preserving D2a null reductions?

scientific_scope.included: D2b two-timescale (H_A, H_K) state dynamics specification only
scientific_scope.excluded: D2b implementation, D3 phenotype protocol, HDP, observable adaptation claims

containment_ladder.display: classical emitter subset static RBS emitter subset dynamic RBS emitter subset activity-coupled RBS emitter
containment_ladder.d2b: activity writes H_A then H_A writes H_K

rbs_vector.doctrine: RBS reference coordinates need not universally equal 1; use 1 for multiplicative relative states and 0 for deviation/trace coordinates when explicitly typed

causal_chain.phenotype_not_preregistered: H_K up does not imply firing down

activity_input_S.definition: per-neuron spike indicator at Euler step n after threshold crossing
activity_input_S.normalization: binary spike event per step (timestep-independent unit event)
activity_input_S.note: low-pass activity trace is H_A, not raw S

H_K.discrete_euler: H_K^{n+1} = H_K^n + dt * ((1 - H_K^n) + kappa_AK * H_A^n) / tau_K

coupling_constant.sign_semantics: kappa_AK > 0: recent activity increases effective K-associated recovery state
coupling_constant.state_level_interpretation: S up => H_A up => H_K up (not a preregistered spike-count phenotype)

timescales.rationale: activity history written quickly; recovery state relaxes more slowly

discrete_update_ordering.forbidden: same-step instantaneous S^n -> H_A^{n+1} -> H_K^{n+1} without using H_A^n in H_K update

kappa_AK_zero.reduction: exact D2a autonomous H_K dynamics (H_A may evolve but does not write H_K)

reference_equilibrium.label: RBS reference equilibrium under no activity

analytic_post_stimulus_contract.h_K_ode: tau_K * dh_K/dt = -h_K + kappa_AK * H_A(0) * exp(-t / tau_A)
analytic_post_stimulus_contract.use: analytic/discrete two-timescale recovery receipt before D3 implementation
analytic_post_stimulus_contract.note: closed-form h_K(t) is sum of exponentials when tau_A != tau_K

success_criteria_state_space: H_A causally writes H_K per discrete ordering
H_K remains in admissible positive domain
post-stimulus recovery matches analytic/discrete two-timescale model
